value.message: Admins can create security policies to monitor and alert users about specific events within their ServiceNow instance. For instance, a user being locked out will trigger an alert if the policy is configured on their instance. Custom policies can also be created to combine multiple conditions.
Click to configure security banner announcements on your instance.

A custom policy combines multiple conditions, each based on a unique trigger that determines when the policy will run. You may add conditions after you create the policy. Learn how to create a custom policy.
Choose the event type for policy creation
Turn on Security banner announcements to receive alerts about major security risks to your instance.

With this tool, customize specific monitoring notifications to alert you when security events occur. Set up thresholds and policies that when triggered will notify you. Get in depth information of when policies and thresholds are triggered and who gets notified.
